text: Lesson 1 named a real gap: nobody outside the data team can tell what any of this actually does. This lesson closes it with real, generated documentation and a lineage graph.

dbt docs generate reads every model, every description, every test, and every ref and source call in the project, and builds a static site from it. dbt docs serve makes that site viewable in a browser.

The generated lineage graph draws the real dependency chain: raw customers into staging into the customers mart, raw orders through staging and the orders mart, raw payments through the payment summary. Every arrow is a real call in the code, never drawn by hand.
This is the same graph Lesson 12's dbt ls command already queried as text — now visible to anyone, including a business stakeholder who's never touched a terminal.

Generated docs can't drift out of date the way a separately maintained wiki can, because every page comes straight from the project's own real files. Next: making the tests behind these docs an actual enforced gate, not just a nice-to-have.
